name: Senior-FigTrans
author: XiaoN
capabilities: Reference-led reconstruction of editable text, shapes, paths, groups and native connectors
Preserving accepted layouts, typography, palettes and local edits
Native file save/reopen, package inspection, visual review and representative edit/move checks
Native Visio text formula guidance with character-range subscripts; MathType remains a distinct optional requirement
requirements: An available Codex environment with the skill installed
Windows PowerShell 5.1 and installed desktop PowerPoint/Visio for the bundled COM helper
Python 3 for the standard-library package auditor
Separately available MathType integration if real MathType objects are requested
limitations: This website does not provide an online conversion backend
The primitive scene helper does not recognize images or automatically build advanced groups, charts, icons or equation OLE
Atomic photos and approved illustrations remain images; object counts do not establish complete fidelity
Target-host availability and requested equation technology must be verified for each task
